title: Zina Saunders
description: "I like to do portraits and action pictures and experiment with interesting angles of perspective. I got to combine them all in this portrayal of Luke and Leia on the Death Starr" says Zina Saunders. She started to draw and painat home as a young girl, inspired and instructed by her father, Norman Saunders, one of the premier illustrators of pulp magazines in the '30s, '40s, '50s, and (he painted Topps classic MARS ATTACKS cards). Zina's illustrations have been used in advertising, theater posters, books and videocassette covers, including GODZILLA VS. THE SEA MONSTER and GODZILLA VS. MECHA-GODZILLA.
